mentions.note: Parent of Olive Garden down 3%; screaming for help; consumer eating out less.
Fabulous restaurant chain (Olive Garden); almost always surprises upside like clockwork. Gas prices coming down and that historically drives Darden performance for 25 years I followed it.
Olive Garden same-store sales beat expectations; positioned to capture consumer spending surge as inflation falls and rates decline.
Olive Garden has minimal beef exposure while competitors suffer on soaring beef costs. Stock crushing it.
